scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text: I'll start explaining the operation. First of all...

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text:
I'll start explaining the operation. First of all...
...... now you can run wild.

scripts.speaker: Rebellion
scripts.text: Something seems to have exploded over there. The flames have risen from the front!

scripts.speaker: Rebellion
scripts.text: There are 4 identified locations these explosion came from! I have ^FF0000shown them on your minimap.^000000

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text:
It's quite sudden but, I'm changing the operation.
Don't worry about those already at the front, they adjust to any situation.

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text: Divide into 4 teams, everyone at their own locations and start suppressing the leads. If any team finds Elyumina, let us know immediately.

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text: Everyone, to your position! Start the operation!

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text: I ask you to act separately adventurer. Please check your ^0000CDminimap^000000 to organize the situation as quickly as possible. Join the team if they need support!

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text:
The briefing... the criminal here will be the one to do it.
It's hard to babysit criminals.

scripts.speaker: Elyumina
scripts.text: Haha! Isn't that your job? Do it properly. Why are you leaving the briefing to me?

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text: So noisy. Before we get started. Are you part of the USU now?

scripts.speaker: Elyumina
scripts.text:
That, that's what he said... are you afraid that I'll be scared!
Heh, I'll do the explaining because I want to take care of my children!

scripts.speaker: Elyumina
scripts.text:
... Okay, it's almost time.
My children will start setting up traps in <TIPBOX>[four places]<INFO>8086</INFO></TIPBOX>.

scripts.speaker: Elyumina
scripts.text:
Here, take the map. The information will also be delivered to the party members as well.
You aren't alone right? You know my children are powerful?

scripts.speaker: Elyumina
scripts.text:
Go ahead and touch the traps. The traps will activate and my lovely children will appear.
You do remember how the traps work, right?

scripts.speaker: Elyumina
scripts.text: After you've cleared the four traps, EL1_A17T will come out, and this lady here will bring you to the same place as last time.

scripts.speaker: Elyumina
scripts.text: That's it for the explanation. Now, get to work! Muscle idiots! Ahahaha!

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text: ...I'll have a conversation with this criminal in a bit... Anyways. I'm counting on you, adventurers!

scripts.speaker: Elyumina
scripts.text:
That was fast... It was expected that my kids wouldn't win though.
There's a lot more trouble going on up there~

scripts.speaker: Elyumina
scripts.text: ... are you going straight for my EL1-A17T?
Go in.
Don't go in yet.

scripts.speaker: Elyumina
scripts.text: Come on, I was about to open it.

scripts.speaker: Elyumina
scripts.text: Hahaha! Yes. Let's work hard. Gather more battle data for me!

scripts.speaker: Rebellion
scripts.text: There is a suspicious box! A signal is being transmitted from the inside, it's currently being decrypted!

scripts.speaker: Rebellion
scripts.text: Destroy the Biological Battery and kill the monsters!

scripts.speaker: Rebellion
scripts.text: Sorry for the late analysis. It wasn't a device to summon monsters.

scripts.speaker: Rebellion
scripts.text: After summoning the monsters, it summons a bio-battery to strengthen the monsters and explodes.

scripts.speaker: Rebellion
scripts.text: If you want to handle it, just destroy it. It's good because it's a simple solution.

scripts.speaker: Rebellion
scripts.text: Well, it looks like this is over....

scripts.speaker: Rebellion
scripts.text: It looks like you've found something interesting here. You should check out the other teams!

scripts.speaker: Rebellion
scripts.text: The cause of the explosion is unknown, but I've found this suspicious box at the site. It seems to be some type of mechanism.

scripts.speaker: Rebellion
scripts.text: There is a signal being transmitted from the inside... Huh, be careful. Something's happening!

scripts.speaker: Rebellion
scripts.text: Destroy the Biological Battery and kill the monsters!

scripts.speaker: Rebellion
scripts.text: There is a suspicious box! A signal is being transmitted from the inside, it's currently being decrypted!

scripts.speaker: Rebellion
scripts.text: Avoid the Chemical Poison and kill the monsters!

scripts.speaker: Rebellion
scripts.text: It's an awful but interesting device. It wasn't a device meant to summon monsters.

scripts.speaker: Rebellion
scripts.text: After summoning monsters, it constantly releases chemical poison, making it even more difficult to remove the monster.

scripts.speaker: Rebellion
scripts.text: If you touch the chemical poison, it will spread like bomb. You shouldn't get any closer.

scripts.speaker: Rebellion
scripts.text: So, it looks like this is over, I'll go join another team! You should too.

scripts.speaker: Rebellion
scripts.text: The cause of the explosion is unknown, but I've found this suspicious box at the site. It seems to be some type of mechanism.

scripts.speaker: Rebellion
scripts.text: There is a signal being transmitted from the inside... Huh, be careful. Something's happening!

scripts.speaker: Rebellion
scripts.text: Avoid the Chemical Poison and kill the monsters!
- Smoke is rising from the suspicious box. -
Have you done this already?
Are you still silent?

scripts.speaker: Rebellion
scripts.text: *Nods, nods*
- Let's go support another team. -

scripts.speaker: Rebellion
scripts.text: Did I tell you that I'm really happy working with the Secret Wing? Thanks to them, I was chosen for this operation.

scripts.speaker: Rebellion
scripts.text: Let's show them what we're all about, and that we're good guys.

scripts.speaker: Rebellion
scripts.text: I haven't seen you in a while adventurer.

scripts.speaker: Rebellion
scripts.text: I already know you adventurer, but please be careful.

scripts.speaker: Rebellion
scripts.text: Hello adventurer.

scripts.speaker: Rebellion
scripts.text: It was nice to be part of this squad, we've already taken care of this box.

scripts.speaker: Rebellion
scripts.text: These machines uses chemical poison, be careful.

scripts.speaker: Rebellion
scripts.text: We will now conduct our search, until the signal comes. Adventurer, be careful!

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text:
I've been waiting for you. I've found the crazy researcher.
The other guys are surrounding the place.

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text: In order to control such a machine in such a fine manner, Elyumina must be around.

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text: It would be possible for me to handle this machine, but then I wouldn't be able to catch Elyumina.

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text: If you take care of the machine, the other search parties will take care of finding Elyumina.

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text: The Rebellion squad is well coordinated, this work will be best suited for us. So leave that task to us.

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text: The place we'll enter will be at 9 o'clock. I confirmed that nobody was hiding there, and we blocked the exits.

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text: Give me a signal when you're ready to get in. I'll tell the squad to let you in.
Give signal.
Not yet.

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text: Yes it's a dangerous opponent to face. I'm sorry to have to leave you alone to fight. Let me know when you're ready.

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text: Okay, watch out! I opened the portal so that you can go in. It's a one way entry, so make sure you're prepared!

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text: Oh, yes. You've worked hard again this time. It's quite tough! How long do we have to use that scrap of metal for it to stop?

scripts.speaker: Elyumina
scripts.text: Didn't I say not to call it scrap of metal?! You idiot!

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text: Yeah yeah, it wasn't a scrap metal at first. But now we've caught it, it's scrap metal. Anyway, you've worked hard. You go back and rest now.
Go back.
Stay for a moment.

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text: Alright, let me know when you're ready to go out.

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text: Good job. It's funny that we have to do this again tomorrow. See you tomorrow.

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text:
Well done, {0}. The operation was a success!
I ran away also, It's quite embarrassing since you knocked down that huge scrap of metal. I also captured something mesmerizing.

scripts.speaker: Elyumina
scripts.text:
Scrap metal! It's a masterpiece! My great child!
You! You... hurt my child! You destroyed my child!

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text:
Did you just call those scraps children?
Well, your children are probably good. Then let's go pay the price for your children's mistakes.

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text: What are you going to do now {0}?
I'm going right back.
I'll stay here for a bit

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text: Alright, let me know when you're ready to go out.

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text: Good work. We'll be clearing things up here, you can take a break. I'm going to interrogate her. Take a break and then come back to me.
